text.id: cueButton(cuePage(page2)_dur(20))_style(size:"120x80", color:"#008", label:"Go to Page 2 then exit page mode")
cueButton(cuePage(page2)_wait(1))_style(size:"120x80", color:"#008", label:"Go to Page 2 then wait()") -3
cueButton(cueNav(mode(scroll)))_style( label:"Exit Page Mode", color:"crimson", fontsize:20, font:"Arial Black", radius:12 )

tspan.tspan: The cueNav command provides navigation control within OscillaScore, allowing performers or
the score itself to jump between pages or switch display modes during playback. A cue like
cueNav(goto(page1)) directs the system to load a specific page, while cueNav(mode(scroll))
exits page mode and returns to the continuous scrolling score view. In addition to simple
“goto” and “mode” actions, cueNav supports optional parameters such as timed transitions
(_wait(n)), chained cues (triggering additional actions after navigation), and integration
with the broader cue system—meaning navigation can be synchronized across clients or linked
to other events like media playback or repeats.
It effectively serves as the bridge between static pages and fluid scrolling navigation,
giving composers precise control over the score’s visual and temporal flow.
